name: typescript-lsp
description: TypeScript and JavaScript code intelligence for Claude Code (go to definition, find references, symbols, hover) that also works on TypeScript 7. A project whose node_modules carries TypeScript 7 gets the language server TypeScript 7 ships (`tsc --lsp`), since it no longer has the tsserver.js other servers drive; every other project gets typescript-language-server.

com.nexaedge.marketplace.tagline: TypeScript code intelligence that also works on TypeScript 7
